src: const t = box(60, 40, 30); const sk = sketch('top'); sk.polygon([[1.3,8.4],[10,8.4],[1.3,11.7]]); groove(sk, t, 90);

brep.refused: groove groove1: brep-rs supports only profiles parallel or perpendicular to the axis yet -- groove1 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): the ring lies completely inside the part, so cutting it would leave a sealed hollow with no opening, which cannot be built reliably here; let the ring reach the outside of the part.
